gen-fs-quilon-gf-kufam: Kufam draws every stroke like a neon sign tube, bright and unwavering. Quilon above it thickens and thins faintly, giving the headline a commanding editorial lean while the sans text below stays uniform and direct.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-lexend-deca: Editorial punch from Quilon, whose strokes shift moderately in weight, over Lexend Deca, a sans whose line never swells at all. Let Quilon take the bigger sizes and leave text to Lexend Deca.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-miriam-libre: Quilon brings commanding editorial shading to both its round and straight strokes. Miriam Libre, with stroke widths that hold from stem to curve, would carry paragraphs along at a steady, approachable pace.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Wide-spaced and sizable, Mochiy Pop P One keeps a constant stroke width under Quilon's gradual weight shifts. And the sans-serif body gives that editorial heading room to command while the text stays plainly approachable.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-montserrat-alternates: Watercolor-soft shading in Quilon meets Montserrat Alternates, whose rims match its stems and whose c opens like a bent paperclip. Shrink Quilon and its gentle shading would fade into the text.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-nata-sans: Quilon carries a faint nib-pressure variation across every round letter. Nata Sans, with its technical-pen steadiness and crossbars matching its stems, feels like a ruler laid beside a nib.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Quilon tapers modestly, like a sharpened carpenter's pencil line, giving the heading an editorial, commanding lean. Noto Kufi Arabic, a modern sans-serif with a welcoming gap in its c, would keep paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans: Quilon is built for statements, with shading across round and straight strokes. Noto Sans does the quieter job, its large lowercase bodies and generously open c keeping long text steady.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart and lets lowercase c, s and z stand tall and full. And Quilon's gentle modulation keeps the heading commanding while paragraphs below stay comfortable.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoine: Quilon draws thin strokes at about half the weight of thick ones. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined, with generous space between curve ends and stem, would carry paragraphs with a modern, steady rhythm.
